An https image URL is extracted into metadata.images when extract_metadata is true

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p><img src="https://example.com/photo.jpg" alt="A photo"></p>'
    options = ConversionOptions(extract_metadata=True)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result)

main()
```
